verdict.rationale: pnpm is a local CLI package manager that operates directly on plain-text files (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml) already in open formats on the user's own disk — there is no hosted account, proprietary data store, or vendor lock-in to 'export from and leave.' The data-portability/exit axis is a category mismatch for a local dev tool rather than a SaaS/data platform.
